field: One farmer plant rice for im farm.
field-2: E clear di land, pull weeds and care for di plants as e dey wait for harvest.
birds-2: Every day dem dey fly come chop di rice.
birds-3: “Leave my crop alone!” di farmer shout.
guard: E run between di plants, dey wave im hands.
guard-2: Di birds scatter, but anytime e comot, dem return.
guard-3: Soon e dey spend more time chasing birds than caring for im farm.
guard-4: E tire, but im rice still dey disappear.
plan: One afternoon, e stop to shout and watch dem.
plan-2: When e move near dem, dem fly away.
plan-3: When e stand far, dem wait.
plan-4: Once dem think say e don go, dem land for di farm again.
animal: E kill one animal and remove di intestines.
animal-2: E carry dem go farm, lie down among di rice and put dem across im belle.
animal-3: Anybody wey see am go think say e don die.
still: Then e lie down without moving at all.
watch: Di birds appear, but dem no come near at first.
watch-2: Na di same man wey always dey chase dem.
quiet-3: Dem wait for di shout wey dem know, but everywhere quiet.
quiet-4: Di farmer fit hear dia wings and feet among di plants.
closer-2: Dem believe say di farmer don die, so dem gather closer until im hands fit reach dem.
caught-2: Before dem fit escape, e catch dem.
caught-3: Di man wey dem think say don die still dey alive, and im trick work.
safe: From dat day, those birds no disturb im farm again.
safe-2: Di farmer fit care for im rice without spending every hour chasing dem.
title: When harvest time reach, im work no waste.
title-2: Na why dem call dis story Di Death of di Rice Farmer.
end: E stop to repeat wetin no work, study im problem and find another way to protect im crop.
still.ask: Why the farmer pretend say e don die?
caught.ask: How the farmer protect im farm?
